name: oracle-learning-library
description: Build pipeline for bundling and tree-shaking workshop assets

scripts.build:css: mkdir -p build && cat workshops/common-content/css/*.css > build/tmp.css && postcss build/tmp.css --config build/postcss.config.js -o workshops/common-content/css/site.min.css && rm build/tmp.css
scripts.build: npm run build:js && npm run build:css
